question: Internet uses:
solution:
The correct answer is __**packet switching**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Packet switching** is a digital networking communications method that groups all transmitted data into suitably sized blocks, called packets, which are transmitted via a medium that may be shared by multiple simultaneous communication sessions.
 
• Unlike circuit switching, which establishes a dedicated circuit for the duration of a transmission, **packet switching** allows the same data path to be shared among many users in the network.
 
• The internet primarily uses packet switching to transfer data efficiently and reliably.
 
• Packet switching helps in reducing network congestion and improving the robustness of data transmission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Telex Switching:**

 
 
• Telex is a switched network of teleprinters similar to a telephone network, for the purposes of sending text-based messages.
 
• It was widely used for international business communication before email and fax became common.
 
 
 
• **Telephone Switching:**
 
 
• Telephone switching refers to the process of connecting telephone calls between the calling and the called party in a telephone network.
 
• This system uses circuit switching technology, where a dedicated path is established for the duration of the call.
 
 
 
• **Circuit Switching:**
 
 
• Circuit switching is a method of implementing a telecommunications network in which two network nodes establish a dedicated communications channel (circuit) through the network before the nodes may communicate.
 
• This type of switching is used in traditional telephone networks.
 
 
 
• **Packet Switching:**
 
 
• Packet switching is a method of grouping data that is transmitted over a digital network into packets.
 
• Packets are sent independently over the network and can take different paths to the destination, where they are reassembled in the correct order.
 
• This method is more efficient and robust than circuit switching and is the foundation of the internet and most modern data networks.
